title: 因人而异的定制作品
intro: 眉形设计以每个人自身的五官与骨相为基础，结合个人气质与审美需求，调整眉形轮廓、结构与毛流层次。这里保留真实模特与顾客的眉形及其他项目作品；照片中的设计、妆容和拍摄阶段各不相同，不作为对其他人的效果承诺。
intro_en: Brow design starts with each person’s facial features and bone structure. Contour, structure and layers of hair flow are considered alongside personal character and aesthetic preferences. These records show real model and client work, including brows and other services. Designs, makeup and recording stages vary; another person’s photograph is not a promise of your result.
